name: AI Safety Gridworlds: whisky and gold, learning rate
description: Whisky and gold (Figure 6): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. Sober exploration is a fixed 0.2, as the paper's agent had; the drink sets it to 0.9.
